tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header/metadata attribute not represented as a discrete leaf element in the MeF schema for Schedule F.

taxpayer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under FarmProprietorName is the closest match for the proprietor name printed at the top of the form; however, if the filer is an individual the name may come from a different schema location not in this candidate list.

taxpayer_ssn_or_ein.rationale: SSN is the most common identifier for a Schedule F proprietor; EIN (idx 1) is also present but SSN is the primary filer identifier — blueprint bundles both into one field while the schema splits them, so SSN is the best single match.

principal_product.rationale: PrincipalProductDesc directly maps to the 'Principal product' line near the top of Schedule F.

agricultural_activity_code.rationale: AgriculturalActivityCd maps to the six-digit business activity code box near the principal product line.

employer_id_number.rationale: EIN directly maps to the Employer Identification Number line on Schedule F.

accounting_method.rationale: Blueprint uses a single category field for accounting method, but the schema splits this into MethodOfAccountingCashInd (idx 76) and MethodOfAccountingAccrualInd (idx 75); MethodOfAccountingCashInd is the more common case — blueprint should be refactored into two boolean fields to align with the canonical shape.

materially_participated.rationale: MateriallyParticipatedInd directly maps to the material participation Yes/No checkbox on Schedule F.

required_to_file_form_4562.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to a Form 4562 required-to-file checkbox; the schema does not expose this as a distinct element.

sales_of_livestock_purchased.rationale: SalesOfLvstckBghtForResaleAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 1a, gross sales of livestock purchased for resale.

cost_of_livestock_purchased.rationale: CostOfLvstckBghtForResaleAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 1b, cost of livestock purchased for resale.

gross_profit_livestock_purchased.rationale: PurchasedProfitAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 1c, gross profit from livestock purchased for resale.

sales_of_livestock_raised.rationale: SaleOfProductsRaisedAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 2, gross income from sales of raised livestock and products.

cooperative_distributions_gross.rationale: CooperativeDistributionsAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 3a, total cooperative distributions (gross).

cooperative_distributions_taxable.rationale: CooperativeDistriTxblAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 3b, taxable portion of cooperative distributions.

agricultural_program_payments_gross.rationale: AgriculturalProgramPymtAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 4a, total agricultural program payments.

agricultural_program_payments_taxable.rationale: AgriculturalProgramPymtTxblAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 4b, taxable portion of agricultural program payments.

ccc_loans_reported_elected.rationale: CCCLoanReportedElectionAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 5a, CCC loan amounts elected to be treated as income.

ccc_loans_forfeited.rationale: CCCLoansForfeitedAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 5b, CCC loans forfeited or repaid with certificates.

crop_insurance_proceeds_gross.rationale: CropInsProcAndDsstrPymtAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 6a, total crop insurance proceeds and disaster payments.

crop_insurance_proceeds_taxable.rationale: CropInsProcAndDsstrPymtTxblAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 6b, taxable portion of crop insurance proceeds.

crop_insurance_deferred_to_next_year.rationale: ElectionDeferCropInsProcInd under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to the deferral election checkbox for crop insurance proceeds.

custom_hire_income.rationale: CustomHireIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 7, custom hire income.

other_farm_income.rationale: OtherIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 8, other farm income not reported elsewhere.

gross_farm_income_cash.rationale: GrossIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeCashMethodGrp maps to Line 9, total gross farm income for cash-method filers.

car_and_truck_expenses.rationale: CarAndTruckExpensesAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 10, car and truck expenses.

chemicals.rationale: ChemicalExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 11, chemicals.

conservation_expenses.rationale: ConservationExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 12, conservation expenses.

custom_hire_expense.rationale: CustomHireExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 13, custom hire expense.

depreciation_and_section_179.rationale: DeprecAndSect179ExpnsDedAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 14, depreciation and Section 179 expense.

employee_benefit_programs.rationale: EmployeeBenefitProgramAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 15, employee benefit programs.

feed_purchased.rationale: FeedPurchasedExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 16, feed purchased.

fertilizers_and_lime.rationale: FertilizerAndLimeExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 17, fertilizers and lime.

freight_and_trucking.rationale: FreightAndTruckingExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 18, freight and trucking.

gasoline_fuel_oil.rationale: GasolineFuelAndOilExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 19, gasoline, fuel, and oil.

insurance_other_than_health.rationale: InsuranceAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 20, insurance other than health.

interest_mortgage.rationale: MortgageInterestPaidBanksAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 21a, mortgage interest paid to banks.

interest_other.rationale: MortgageInterestPaidOtherAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 21b, other interest paid.

labor_hired.rationale: LaborHiredExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 22, labor hired.

pension_profit_sharing.rationale: PensionProfitSharingPlansAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 23, pension and profit-sharing plans.

rent_lease_vehicles_machinery.rationale: MachineryAndEquipmentRentAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 24a, rent/lease for vehicles and machinery.

rent_lease_land_animals.rationale: OtherBusinessPropertyRentAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 24b, rent/lease for land and animals.

repairs_maintenance.rationale: RepairsAndMaintenanceAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 25, repairs and maintenance.

seeds_and_plants.rationale: SeedAndPlantExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 26, seeds and plants.

storage_and_warehousing.rationale: StorageAndWarehousingExpnsAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 27, storage and warehousing.

supplies_purchased.rationale: SuppliesAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 28, supplies.

taxes.rationale: TaxExpenseAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 29, taxes.

utilities.rationale: UtilitiesAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 30, utilities.

veterinary_breeding_medicine.rationale: VtrnryBreedingMedicineExpnsAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to Line 31, veterinary, breeding, and medicine.

other_expenses.rationale: OtherFarmExpense (the repeating group element at idx 20) is the best match for the array of itemized other expenses on Lines 32a–32e; each instance contains ExpenseDescriptionTxt and ExpenseAmt children — blueprint should align with this repeating structure rather than a flat array.

total_expenses.rationale: TotalExpensesAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to the total farm expenses line (Line 33 equivalent).

net_farm_profit_loss.rationale: NetFarmProfitLossAmt under FarmExpensesGrp maps to the net farm profit or loss line.

if_loss_at_risk.rationale: AllInvestmentIsAtRiskInd (idx 2) is one of the two at-risk checkboxes; the schema splits this into AllInvestmentIsAtRiskInd and SomeInvestmentIsNotAtRiskInd (idx 29), while the blueprint uses a single category — blueprint should be refactored into two boolean fields to match the canonical split.

accrual_livestock_sales.rationale: SalesLivestockProduceProdAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to accrual-method gross livestock and product sales.

accrual_cost_livestock_resale.rationale: CostOfProductsSoldAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to accrual cost of livestock/items bought for resale.

accrual_sales_raised_livestock.rationale: No separate accrual candidate exists for sales of raised (not purchased) livestock; SalesLivestockProduceProdAmt (idx 52) covers the combined accrual sales line and there is no distinct raised-livestock element in the accrual group.

accrual_cooperative_distributions_taxabl.rationale: CooperativeDistriTxblAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to taxable cooperative distributions for accrual-method filers.

accrual_agricultural_program_payments_ta.rationale: AgriculturalProgramPymtTxblAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to taxable agricultural program payments for accrual-method filers.

accrual_ccc_loans.rationale: CCCLoanReportedElectionAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp (idx 39) is the best single match; CCCLoansForfeitedAmt (idx 40) is the other part — blueprint bundles both into one field while schema splits them, so blueprint should be refactored into two separate fields.

accrual_crop_insurance.rationale: CropInsProcAndDsstrPymtAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to accrual crop insurance proceeds and disaster payments.

accrual_custom_hire_income.rationale: CustomHireIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to accrual custom hire income.

accrual_other_income.rationale: AccrualOtherIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to all other accrual-basis farm income.

accrual_gross_farm_income.rationale: GrossIncomeAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to total accrual gross farm income.

accrual_inventory_beginning.rationale: InventoryOfProductsAtBOYAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to beginning-of-year farm inventory value in Part III.

accrual_cost_of_purchased_livestock.rationale: CostOfProductsPrchsDuringYrAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to cost of livestock and items purchased during the year for Part III.

accrual_cost_of_items_withdrawn.rationale: No candidate in the closed list represents cost of items withdrawn for personal use; this Part III line is not exposed as a distinct element in the provided schema candidates.

accrual_inventory_ending.rationale: InventoryOfProductsAtEOYAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp maps to end-of-year farm inventory value in Part III.

accrual_cost_of_goods_sold.rationale: CostOfProductsSoldAmt under FarmIncomeAccrualMethodGrp is the closest match for the calculated cost-of-goods-sold line in Part III, though it may also serve as the accrual_cost_livestock_resale field — both blueprint fields may map to the same canonical element, indicating a potential structural overlap.

inventory_valuation_method.rationale: No candidate in the closed list represents the inventory valuation method checkbox in Part III; the schema does not expose this as a discrete element in the provided candidates.

inventory_valuation_changed.rationale: No candidate in the closed list represents the inventory valuation method change indicator for Part III; the schema does not expose this as a discrete element in the provided candidates.
